posts.author: ASimpleShrine550
posts.body:
here's an animator's technique from keyframing:
find a base source of such character
(maybe a online image of a real person.)
then draw a sprite based on it to your anime-liking.
Then REDRAW IT OVER and OVER again until it animates.
You can use copy and paste methods to make movement
but you have to edit them to make it look natural regardless
try an
online search
somehow if you need additional help.
